blog_guides.title: How to Change & Reset Password in JMRi ERP?
blog_guides.text:
Two way to Change & Reset Password in Odoo Application,  

Case 1 : 

Login to Odoo with your username and password, at the top right menu, click on  P references , click on buttton  Change Password  in wizard. 

Case 2 : 

Open Odoo web page - type your email id & click on button Reset Password , a reset password link send to your email address.

A great way to catch your reader's attention is to tell a story. Everything you consider writing can be told as a story.

Great stories have personality. Consider telling a great story that provides personality. Writing a story with personality for potential clients will asist with making a relationship connection. This shows up in small quirks like word choices or phrases. Write from your point of view, not from someone else's experience.

Great stories are for everyone even when only written for just one person. If you try to write with a wide general audience in mind, your story will ring false and be bland. No one will be interested. Write for one person. If it’s genuine for the one, it’s genuine for the rest.

blog_guides.title: Mass Mailing in JMRi ERP
blog_guides.text:
Mass Mailing 

Odoo’s Mass Mailing module allows you to easily send mass mails to your contacts, leads, opportunities and customers. You can track the performance of mailing campaigns to improve conversion rates. 

It gives feature to design professional email templates and reuse templates in just a few clicks. 

Steps : 

1. Create List

2. Create or Import E-mails in List

3. Design Mail Template

4. Create Mass Mailing Campaign 

Let’s start in Odoo.

Firstly, Create a new Mailing List.

(Marketing → Mailing List → Mailing List) 

Then, Import a database of prospects or create and add new Emails or filter on existing leads, opportunities and lists of customers in no time at all. 

(Marketing → Mailing List → Contacts) 

The next step is to define email templates or reuse the content or specific design for your newsletter. Here I am using existing Newsletter. 

(Marketing → Mass Mailing → Mail Templates) 

You can Edit it as required. 

Odoo gives very user friendly WYSWYG environment to create Mail Templates. 

Click on Edit Template to open Template Editor. 

Now easily manage your mailing campaigns with simple, user friendly and powerful options. 

(Marketing → Mass Mailing → Mass Mailing) 

Manage the whole marketing campaign just at one single place 

Get the real time statistics on the performance of Mail campaigns to improve your conversion rate. Track emails sent, received, opened, replied and answered. 

This is the way how Odoo manages mass mailing so you do not need to go for any other mass mailing tool, everything is completely integrated in Odoo.

blog_guides.title: How to apply leaves in JMRi ERP?
blog_guides.text:
Leave Management in Odoo 

Leave Request : 

Human Resources -- Leaves -- Leave Request 

User: Employee 

Step 1 - Creating Leave Request 

Users need to Enter the Mandatory fields in Leave Request 

Choose your Allocated Leave Type – Casual , Sick, Emergency, Maternity and Paternity 

Choose Duration – Start Date and End Date 

Partial Leave - Start Day / End Day ( Employee have option to Apply here ) 

Enter Reason for Leave. 

Step 2 - Confirming Leave Request 

Click Save and Confirm 

Leaves Request Number will Generates and Duration Days calculated automatically. 

Email notification to Manager for approval 

 

Human Resources -- Leaves -- Leave Request To Approve 

User: Manager 

Step 3 - Approve / Refuse Leave Request 

Manager Comments Required for Approving or Refusing requested Leaves 

Once Leaves Requested Approved – Leaves will be deducted in Employee Allocation

blog_guides.title: How to apply Attendance Regularisation in JMRi ERP?
blog_guides.text:
Attendance Regularisation in Odoo 

Regularisation Request : 

Human Resources -- Leaves -- Attendance Regularisation 

User: Employee 

Step 1 - Create Regularisation Request   -  ** Regularisation can be applied only for Absent Days ** 

Users need to Enter the Mandatory fields in Leave Request 

Choose Type – On Duty and Work From Home. 

Choose Dates – Start Date and End Date 

Partial Day – Start Day / End Day ( Employee have option to Apply here ) 

Enter Reason for Regularisation. 

Step 2 - Confirming Regularisation Request 

Click Save and Confirm 

Regularisation Request Number will Generates and Duration Days calculated automatically. 

Email notification to Manager for approval 

Step 3 - Approve / Refuse Regularisation Request 

Manager Comments Required for Approving or Refusing requested Regularisation 

Once Regularisation Requeste Approved – Leaves will be not deducted. 

Notes: 

** Onsite Resource are requested to Fill Timesheet –  Attendance Regularization Will Auto Update ** 

** Sales Team are requested to do  Attendance Regularization on Weekly Basis **

blog_guides.title: How to Create Lead in JMRi ERP Application by employees?
blog_guides.text:
How Employees need to Create Lead in Application

Lead Generation

Employee Lead Creation: 

Steps To be Followed : 

User: Employee 

Human Resource -- Lead Generation – Lead 

Step 1 - Creating Lead 

Click Create Button 

Subject – Describe about the Lead information 

Account Name is Mandatory – Check the Account Available in Account Tab, If Account is not available enter the proper details in the below mentioned list, 

Account Name 

Address 

Country 

Contact Name 

Email 

Function 

Phone andMobile 

Opportunity Information 

For Opportunity the listed informations are mandatory 

Expected Closing 

Expected Revenue 

Product/Interest Area 

Currency by default USD 

Description – Full description about the client requirement 

Task Date 

Time spent 

Unit 

Task status 

Task Remarks 

Step 2 - Confirming Lead 

Click Save and Confirm the Lead 

On Confirmation email notification send to BU Head for Lead validation by keeping cc with employee name who create this lead 

User: Business Unit Head 

Human Resource -- Lead Generation – Lead 

Step 2   - Convert To Opportuntiy 

Click Convert to Opportunity and this information is updated in CRM Opportunity 

Opportunity Link and Opportunity Status will be displayed here for Employee Reference
